_doc: STATUS per alert source. Facts as of 2026-10-21 (owner ruling D117, research-audit DECISIONS D130), from research-audit research/KILLED.md, research/KILLED_BOOKS.md, research/SCORECARD.csv, research/DECISIONS.md and the forward-test records. Precedence for research evidence: KILLED > FORWARD-PASSED > PAPER > UNPROVEN; an owner ruling sets the alert status where noted (COMBO_02_V1 D51a). Owner ruling D120 (D108: BTC is non-directional only): no directional BTC alert; BTCUSDT is excluded per source in trade_alerts_config.json symbol_exclusions (V1, FWD-1, screener), and CANDLE12_V2 (BTC-only) is dropped (dropped_sources). KILLED sends nothing unless trade_alerts_config.json allow_killed is true (default false, D51). No source has a frozen forward rule that has PASSED, so nothing is FORWARD-PASSED, and every alert, follow-up and summary starts with the D117 line 'UNPROVEN, for observation only, not for trading' (plan.OBSERVATION_PREFIX).

CANDLE12_V2.evidence: Dropped from alerts by owner ruling D120 (D108: BTC is for non-directional strategies only; CANDLE12_V2 is BTC-only, so no alert source is left). Before D120, owner ruling D117 kept it PAPER for observation although the research tournament KILLED CANDLE12_V2|LONG at DISCOVERY Gate 2, E9 (research-audit research/KILLED.md: 56 trades, +0.297 R/trade). Its forward virtual paper in the live app (since 2026-10-17) is not touched; the sidecar ignores its journal rows (sources.py).

PASSED_BOOK.evidence: KILLED_BOOKS.md 2026-10-20 22:35: the passed book as one unit KILLED at DISCOVERY Gate 2 (GATES section 5; 803 trades, net R -50.0 vs random-baseline p90 +36.4); owner ruling D40: live paper keeps it only as a parity test. Sides in KILLED.md at DISCOVERY Gate 2 (E9): COMBO_01, COMBO_02, COMBO_02_CLOSED_HTF, COMBO_02_LOCAL, COMBO_03_TRANSITION and COMBO_03_TRANSITION_B (LONG and SHORT each). COMBO_02_V2 (LONG and SHORT) is NOT_RUN in SCORECARD.csv (the 6-job COMBO_02_V2 family is not run). The book-level kill covers every side it runs. Off by default (allow_killed false).

COMBO_02_V1.evidence: Owner rulings D51a and D117: COMBO_02 v1 (V1) alerts as PAPER, for observation. Forward-tested in live paper (V1_PAPER_WATCHER, BTC/ETH/SOL 1h long). Its research line COMBO_02|LONG is KILLED at DISCOVERY Gate 2, E9 (KILLED.md: 940 trades, -0.134 R/trade); the owner's ruling sets the alert status. D120: BTCUSDT signals are excluded (EXCLUDED_SYMBOL skip), so V1 alerts on ETH and SOL only.

SCREENER.evidence: Generic screener setup signals (SignalEngine ENTRY_CANDIDATE, strategy SCREENER_SETUP) have no backtest row in SCORECARD.csv. Active alert source since 0b4352d (cherry-picked as 65ef14d on live/telegram-alerts-v2): the sidecar alerts on P14 decision-journal rows book SCREENER, event signal (engine final stop and first target; T2 shown as untested; the D63 TP1-to-stop cost band applies). Those rows are written by SetupSignalService in the backend process that holds the paper writer lock, only with DECISION_JOURNAL_SIGNAL_DETAIL=true (P14 flag, default off); with it off the screener sends nothing. D120: BTCUSDT screener signals are excluded (a screener setup is directional; EXCLUDED_SYMBOL skip).
